newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares seen higher on Telkom.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares seen higher on Telkom.

text.p: Jakarta shares are expected to be higher within a narrow range at the opening on Monday, with Telkom giving sentiment a boost following its sharp rise in New York on Friday, brokers said.
But they said some consolidation after big increases in some counters late last week could keep a cap on the index, which closed at 616.89 points on Friday, up 15.98 on the day.
Brokers said Telkom was likely to be actively traded following a report saying the firm was expecting final government approval to introduce a new tariff schedule in January.
Heavyweight cigarette maker Sampoerna was also likely to popular with its stock split coming into effect today, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index jumped 2.66 percent to 616.89 points on Friday. Advancers led decliners by 71 to 40, with 55 counters unchanged.
